translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 TIMOTEO
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat a Timoteo c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: In ey ax in tomnal ca bijiyat ti eyal al an tamcunel ebchalab
Lej chubax pel i lej alhua’ t’ojlab max i ebchalab in le’ ca bijiyat ti eyal c’al an tamcunel ebchalab.

Jitats ca bijiyat in cua’al in uchbil quin t’aja’ ti alhua’ inic ani ni jant’o yab ca elchin yab alhua’. Quin co’oy juncats in tomquil. Ca xe’etsq’ui ani quin t’aja’ lej alhua’ tsalpath tin oc’. Quin t’aja’ tequeth abal antsana’ ta ca c’ac’na c’al an ebchalab. Ets’ey quin lej alhua’ bats’u an tsa’bix tin q’uima’. Quin huit’a’ ti exobchix c’al in cahuintal a Dios.
Yab ca uts’alin ani yab ca hueutsíxin. Yab ca jaylomats c’al i tumin ani yab quin c’ambiy an inicchic tin cuenta an tumin. Quin c’aya’na’ in at inicchic ani ca c’uajiy jun ejet c’al jaja’chic.
Quin huit’a’ ti alhua’ abatnom c’al in q’uimathil ani quin co’oy in tsacamilchic belcax ani c’ac’nax.
Max jun i inic yab in ejtohual ti alhua’ abatnom tin q’uima’, jaquitsq’ui más yab ne’ets quin ejtou ti eyal tin q’uima’ a Dios.

Yab ca bijiyat ti eyal c’al an tamcunel ebchalab i ebchalab axi it huenc’onenec c’al a Dios, cum hualam max quin c’athatna’ tim ba’ abal thubat bijiyab. Max quin c’athatna’ tim ba’ ne’ets ca jolbiyat jaye c’al a Dios ejtil ti jolbiyame an oc’ox teneclab tam tin c’athatna’ tim ba’ ti jayq’ui’.

Axi ca bijiyat in cua’al in uchbil quin t’aja’ jahua’ alhua’ abal antsana’ ta ca c’ac’na jaye c’al axi yab belom c’al a Cristo ani yab expith c’al an ebchalabchic. Quin t’aja’ alhua’ abal yab ca quithab cahuiliyat c’al in at inic ani yab ca c’ambiyat c’al an teneclab.
In ey ax in tomnal ca bijiyat ti tolmix c’al an tamcunel ebchalab

Aniye jaye jitats ca bijiyat ti tolmix c’al an tamcunel ebchalab quin co’oy tequeth in ichich abal antsana’ ta ca c’ac’na c’al an ebchalabchic. Yab quin t’aja’ tuyuyul c’al in cahuintal. Yab ca uts’alin. Yab quin c’ambiy an inicchic tin cuenta an tumin.
Quin lej exla’ an chubaxtalab tin luputh, ani quim putu c’al an chubaxtalab abal i quin ats’a’ jolbith tin cuete’ ichich.
Jitats u le’nab ti tolmix c’al an tamcunel ebchalab ca oc’ox lej t’ajan ti cuenta max in ey alhua’ ejtil nan tu uchal al axe’ xi u. Max quim baju antsana’its in ey, tam jats ca bijiyat.

In tomquil nixe’ xi tolmix jaye quin co’oy tequeth in ichich abal antsana’ ta ca c’ac’na c’al an ebchalabchic. Yab ca xe’tsin ti t’uchichil c’al i cau. Ca xe’etsq’ui ani quim putu c’al patal in uchbil.
Axi ca bijiyat ti tolmix c’al an tamcunel ebchalab quin co’oy juncats in tomquil. Quin ejtou ti alhua’ abatnom c’al in q’uimathil ani c’al in tsacamilchic.

Antsana’ ne’ets ca lej c’ac’na c’al an tamcunel ebchalchic max chubax quin t’aja’ ti alhua’ tolmix. Ne’ets quim baju quin más tsapna’ a Cristo Jesús ani quin más ejtou quin olna’ i cau tin cuenta abal im belal.
Lej luputh an cau ax i belal
U lej le’ quin thubat c’ale tu tsu’u Timoteo, ani biyat axe’ tu thuchanchale hue’ an u.

Max i cu ejtou quin lej thubat c’ale, c’al axe’ xi u nan tu tso’obliyal jantini’ pel i uchbil qui t’aja’ tu juncuth tsacamlab c’al a Dios. Pel huahua’ tu bichohuil a Dios, ani pel in ey a Dios ejat abal ets’ey. I tots’q’uiyal ani i c’aniyal an chubaxtalab max jita’ quin tomolna’.
Chubax ti lej luputh an chubaxtalab jahua’ huahua’ i belal, ma yab i bajuhual qui lej quithat exbay. In ulal an chubaxtalab antse’:

content.text: Chich a Dios teje’ tsabal ca hua’tsin ti inic.
Tejhua’methanchat an inicchic in lej ey ti pututh inic c’al an Espíritu Santo.
Olnanchame an inicchic abal jaja’ pel i Jec’onthax.
Belchame c’al i inicchic tim puhuel an tsabal.
